title: Structural characterization of an intrinsically disordered protein complex using integrated small-angle neutron scattering and computing.
authors: Chen, Serena H; Weiss, Kevin L; Stanley, Christopher; Bhowmik, Debsindhu
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文整合SANS、微秒级全原子MD和自编码器深度学习，表征两个IDR形成的复合物结构系综，直接聚焦无序蛋白复合物互作机制建模，方法新颖且深度高。
abstract: Characterizing structural ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of proteins is essential for studying structure-function relationships. Due to the different neutron scattering lengths of hydrogen and deuterium, selective labeling and contrast matching in small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) becomes an effective tool to study dynamic structures of disordered systems. However, experimental timescales typically capture measurements averaged over multiple conformations, leaving complex SANS data for disentanglement. We hereby demonstrate an integrated method to elucidate the structural ensemble of a complex formed by two IDRs. We use data from both full contrast and contrast matching with residue-specific deuterium labeling SANS experiments, microsecond all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with four molecular mechanics force fields, and an autoencoder-based deep learning (DL) algorithm. From our combined approach, we show that selective deuteration provides additional information that helps characterize structural ensembles. We find that among the four force fields, a99SB-disp and CHARMM36m show the strongest agreement with SANS and NMR experiments. In addition, our DL algorithm not only complements conventional structural analysis methods but also successfully differentiates NMR and MD structures which are indistinguishable on the free energy surface. Lastly, we present an ensemble that describes experimental SANS and NMR data better than MD ensembles generated by one single force field and reveal three clusters of distinct conformations. Our results demonstrate a new integrated approach for characterizing structural ensembles of IDPs.
abstract_zh: 表征 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 和 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 的结构系综对于研究结构-功能关系至关重要。由于氢和氘的中子散射长度不同，选择性标记和对比匹配在小角中子散射 (small-angle neutron scattering, SANS) 中成为研究无序系统动态结构的有效工具。然而，实验时间尺度通常捕获多个构象的平均测量值，留下复杂的SANS数据需要解析。我们在此展示了一种集成方法，用于阐明由两个IDRs形成的复合物的结构系综。我们使用了全对比和残基特异性氘标记SANS实验的数据、微秒级全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟（采用四种分子力学力场），以及基于自编码器的深度学习 (deep learning, DL) 算法。通过我们的组合方法，我们表明选择性氘化提供了有助于表征结构系综的额外信息。我们发现，在四种力场中，a99SB-disp和CHARMM36m与SANS和NMR实验的一致性最强。此外，我们的DL算法不仅补充了传统结构分析方法，还成功区分了在自由能表面上无法区分的NMR和MD结构。最后，我们提出了一个系综，其描述实验SANS和NMR数据的效果优于由单一力场生成的MD系综，并揭示了三个不同构象的簇。我们的结果展示了一种表征IDPs结构系综的新集成方法。
